rules.title: Santa Ana ban on algorithmic rent-setting software
rules.requirement: The proposed ordinance would prohibit selling, licensing, providing and using certain algorithmic rent-setting software for residential rentals in Santa Ana. Affected tenants could sue for injunctive relief, damages, or civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation plus attorney's fees.
rules.requirement_es: La ordenanza propuesta prohibiría vender, otorgar licencias, proporcionar y usar ciertos programas algorítmicos para fijar rentas en viviendas de alquiler en Santa Ana. Los inquilinos afectados podrían demandar para obtener medidas cautelares, daños o sanciones civiles de hasta $1,000 por infracción más honorarios de abogado.
rules.citation: Santa Ana ordinance banning algorithmic rent-setting software (first reading Feb. 17, 2026)
rules.quoted_span: prohibits the sale, licensing, provision and use of certain algorithmic rent-setting software for residential rental properties.
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential rental property within Santa Ana city limits.
rules.exemptions: Does not apply to pricing software that relies solely on publicly available data, aggregate historical data, or tools used to comply with affordable housing program requirements.
rules.penalty: Injunctive relief, damages, or civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation, plus attorney's fees.
rules.caveat: Secondary news source; approved only for first reading on Feb. 17, 2026 with final vote set for March 3, 2026. Final adoption is not shown in the document. Ordinance number and code section not given.
